name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport finance began unexpectedly after he helped a local racing team sort out a tax issue. His meticulous approach and knack for spotting financial inefficiencies caught the attention of several team owners. Despite a late start in the field, Jean-Pierre is determined to rise through the ranks and prove his worth.

He sees his role as more than just balancing books; it's about enabling the team to make data-driven decisions and secure long-term financial stability. Jean-Pierre is a firm believer in transparency and accountability, ensuring that every dollar spent contributes to the team's overall success. He is currently focused on improving his understanding of motorsport-specific regulations and financial models.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Jean-Pierre has a friendly, approachable demeanor with a serious look when he's concentrating.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn book of accounting principles.
Insists on using a traditional calculator for complex equations alongside his computer.
Has a collection of miniature race car models on his desk.
